Advise senior leadership on the state of housing demand and the needs for campus housing growth. Participate in regular budget and strategic planning meetings as a member of the housing and dining senior leadership team.
Develop strategic plans for the Housing Services department that support future growth, service expansion, and evolving student needs.
Design Housing Services department planning on future-oriented growth and service development. Attend systemwide housing services meetings.

Directly supervises professional and/or support staff and is responsible for the full range of supervisory activities, including recruitment, hiring recommendations, onboarding, training, work assignment, performance evaluation, employee development, corrective action, and resolution of employee concerns.
Exercises independent judgment in personnel-related matters and ensures compliance with University policies, procedures, and applicable labor agreements.
Occupancy Management:  Manage all aspects of the StarRez housing management system for UC Merced in collaboration with Procurement and the Office of Information Technology.
Prepare, distribute, process, and manage housing applications and housing agreements.
Track and update housing room inventory, as appropriate. Through use of keen technical capabilities, structure the housing room assignment process.
Lead the planning and logistical coordination of major housing events, including move-in, move-out, intersession housing, and summer academic housing.
Support summer group housing in collaboration with Hospitality Services.
Track and respond to student housing eligibility. In collaboration with the Division of Undergraduate Education, structure annual room block allocations for Living-Learning Communities.

In collaboration with Student Accessibility Services, facilitate room assignments, layout and furniture adjustments, and other reasonable accommodations to students living on campus. Represent Housing Services in recruitment events, including traveling to events when needed.
Business Operations & Budgetary Oversight:
Develop and recommend housing rates based on comprehensive market research and relevant industry data.
Facilitate the room and residential meal plan billing process.
Oversee an annual auxiliary revenue budget of more than $65 million.
Update and manage the Housing Services website, including management of the off-campus housing webpage, rates, and all appliable marketing materials.

Approve housing fund purchasing requests for multiple partner departments, including Auxiliary Facilities Services and Auxiliary Custodial Services, as delegated by the Executive Director of Resident Services. Through support of direct report staff, provide outstanding public-facing service through the Housing Services Desk, the Resident Services Desk, and the Housing Mail Room, including administration of all central phone lines, email accounts, and in-person visitor response.
Using StarRez, Qualtrics, and other critical systems, run regular reports related to housing planning and needs analysis.
Provide occupancy updates to senior leadership.

In collaboration with the Director of Residence Education and the Office of Institutional Effectiveness, implement and analyze the annual housing satisfaction survey for use in continued improvement. Respond to University of California Office of the President requests for information.
Advanced degree in related area from an accredited university (preferred); and
Five years of related experience in student housing management or transferrable experience; and/or
Nine years of related experience in student housing management or transferrable experience in lieu of degree (required).
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including skills in communicating processes and policies to diverse audiences.
Advanced knowledge of housing management systems (StarRez, Residence, eRezLife, etc.).
Experience working with integrated student management systems and data.
Proficient in MS Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, Outlook).
Ability to work under pressure, prioritize deadlines, and juggle multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
Multicultural competence: Ability to understand perspectives and experiences of multiple cultural and social identities.
Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality of student and departmental information.
Experience managing complex customer service operations.
Skills in project management, social perceptiveness to be aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.
Three years of experience in leading and/or supervising groups of people.
Three years of experience serving as a student affairs practitioner or equivalent.
Three years of experience managing financial responsibilities and/or budget oversight.
At least two years of experience as a student housing occupancy subject matter expert.
Skills in monitoring/assessing processes or services, to make improvements.
Ability in problem identification, reasoning, ability to develop original ideas to solve problems, persuasion, leadership, and intercultural competence.
Knowledge of University policies, processes, and procedures.
This position will be required to complete all pre-employment requirements, including a background investigation.
